page: OVHcloud b3-64 is a general-purpose cloud server powered by an AMD EPYC processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture. It features 16 dedicated physical cores with 16 vCPUs operating at a base clock speed of 2.3 GHz. The system does not utilize hyperthreading, allocating exactly one thread per core. It is equipped with 64.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. Local storage is bundled with a 400 GB NVMe SSD, and network connectivity is supported by a 4 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

In benchmark evaluations, the b3-64 demonstrates strong performance in single-core CPU tasks and large-block memory operations. Specifically, stress-ng single-core CPU performance and uncached large-block memory read/write bandwidth fall within the top 25% of tested servers. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and small-model LLM text generation also rank in this upper tier. Conversely, multi-core CPU performance, software compilation, database operations, and medium-model LLM inference speeds align with average mid-range expectations.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced resource distribution, the b3-64 offers a stable, predictable performance profile. The inclusion of local NVMe storage and a complimentary public IPv4 address enhances its resource density without requiring external storage attachments. This configuration is well-suited for applications such as web serving, multi-threaded data processing, medium-scale database hosting, and software development environments.
